changes.description: Initial desktop release
Fixed the system tray menu (right-click) on Windows
Only one backup agent can run per machine; a second launch now shows a clear notice
Automatic updates: in-app download of new versions with verification and release history
Version management, release manifests and CI template
Release builds and the app are named EverBox (everbox.exe, EverBox.app, everbox packages)

Security hardening: update downloads pinned to the manifest host over https, random per-download temp folder, queue replay re-validated against the job folder, https-only endpoints, keychain quoting hardened, log sanitizer covers 40-char secrets
Restore execution: agent downloads restore operations to a local folder (conflict policies, crash-safe writes, cancel); honest SSE copy (no more end-to-end claims)
Settings: restore destination folder picker; History: failed/ignored files listed on partial runs
Updates: the version shown in Settings follows CHANGELOG.json, new versions are checked on the public GitHub release repository, and updates can be installed automatically or manually
Update probe compatibility: manifests served over loopback http are accepted for the local dev/test transport (remote http stays refused)

Release notes: the release repository feed (version + description) is viewable in Settings, and the update notification carries what's new; one-command publishing organizes the release repository at every build
Fix build failure after the file_picker 13 upgrade: directory and save dialogs now use the new static API
Fixed: EverBox no longer shows a black window at startup on macOS — data is now stored inside the App Sandbox container and outbound network access is enabled
Rename upload throttle setting to 'Upload speed' (Mbps = network capacity) instead of 'Bandwidth' to remove ambiguity with data transfer quotas
